text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus announced her participation 
in the upcoming public training session. 
It was the perfect opportunity to spread 
her name as a hero.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being petite and naturally 
well-conditioned, she showed a run during 
the trial that nobody would believe was 
from someone yet to debut. And with that, 
she caught the attention of the onlookers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus was called out to by one of 
the spectators. That person turned out to 
be an aspiring action actor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having also worked as a suit actor for 
Carrotman, the two hit it off immediately. 
Her dream, she shared, was to make it to 
Hollywood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she was worried that she wouldn't 
pass any auditions because she was small 
and lacked stage presence. The two of them 
vowed to give it their all together.
